register.labelZh: DASH 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: dash about、dash around 和 dash round 可以描述某人在不同地點或活動之間匆忙走動。；dash against 可以表示雨水、海浪或海水猛烈拍打某個表面。；dash off 可以描述某人匆忙離開,也可以描述某人迅速寫好一段簡短內容。；dash something away 可以描述某人迅速擦去眼淚,然後繼續進行原本的活動。
register.summaryEn: Dash about, dash around and dash round help you describe somebody moving quickly between different places or activities. Dash against shows rain, waves or the sea striking a surface with force. Dash off may describe somebody leaving in a hurry or producing a short piece of writing very quickly. Dash something away can describe somebody quickly wiping away tears before continuing with an activity.
